policy.name: Operational Resilience Policy
policy.description: Overarching operational resilience policy establishing Board ownership, governance structure, CO/CF framework, impact tolerance methodology, and responsibilities aligned to CBUAE requirements.

policy.name: Resilience Metrics and KRI Policy
policy.description: Defines Board-approved KPIs and KRIs for measuring operational resilience, impact tolerance metrics, measurement framework, and management reporting requirements.

policy.name: CO/CF Identification and Impact Tolerance Policy
policy.description: Defines the methodology for identifying Critical Operations and Critical Functions, setting impact tolerances, and reviewing and updating CO/CF inventories.

policy.name: Service Dependency Mapping Policy
policy.description: Defines requirements for end-to-end mapping of CO/CF resources, dependency identification including Nth parties, and accessibility of mapping during disruptions.

policy.name: Third-Party Service Provider (TPSP) Risk Policy
policy.description: Defines TPSP risk governance, materiality assessment, due diligence standards, contractual requirements, monitoring, exit planning, and Central Bank notification obligations.

policy.name: Business Continuity Policy
policy.description: Defines BCP requirements per CO/CF, RTO/RPO objectives aligned to impact tolerances, fallback procedures, and substitute delivery channels.

policy.name: Crisis Management Policy
policy.description: Defines the crisis management framework, command structure, roles and decision rights, communication protocols, and auditable record requirements.

policy.name: Resilience Testing Policy
policy.description: Defines the annual resilience testing programme, scenario design methodology, severe-but-plausible requirements, TLPT requirements, and governance of test outcomes.

policy.name: Incident Management and Regulatory Reporting Policy
policy.description: Defines end-to-end incident management, detection, classification, escalation, regulatory reporting to CBUAE, evidence preservation, and post-incident review requirements.

policy.name: Vulnerability and Learning Management Policy
policy.description: Defines requirements for identifying vulnerabilities from testing and incidents, integrating into issue management, remediation tracking, and self-assessment incorporation.

policy.name: ICT Risk Management Policy
policy.description: Defines ICT risk framework anchored to CO/CF, risk taxonomy, control framework, KPI/KRI metrics, and independent assurance requirements.

policy.name: Technology Asset Management Policy
policy.description: Defines complete technology asset inventory requirements, CMDB governance, asset classification by CO/CF criticality, lifecycle management, and ownership.

policy.name: Change Management Policy
policy.description: Defines CO/CF change governance, risk assessment using impact tolerance as primary criterion, emergency change procedures, rollback plans, and post-implementation review.

policy.name: Architectural Resilience Policy
policy.description: Defines SPOF identification and mitigation, redundancy patterns, network segmentation, micro-segmentation, zero-trust controls, and graceful degradation requirements.

policy.name: Payment and Financial Market Infrastructure Resilience Policy
policy.description: Defines resilience requirements for payment dependencies including RTGS, SWIFT, interoperability planning, reconciliation controls, and monitoring.

policy.name: Cryptography and Key Management Policy
policy.description: Defines cryptographic standards, key management, post-quantum cryptography readiness, certificate lifecycle management, and HSM requirements.

policy.name: Cyber Detection and Response Policy
policy.description: Defines SOC operating model, SIEM detection requirements, EDR deployment, threat intelligence, cyber playbooks, and regulatory notification integration.

policy.name: Cyber Recovery and Data Protection Policy
policy.description: Defines backup and recovery requirements, 3-2-1 strategy, segregation of recovery environments, outcome-based recovery validation, and independent assurance.

policy.name: Access Control and Identity Management Policy
policy.description: Defines least privilege, strong authentication, MFA mandates, PAM requirements, access reviews, JML controls, and anomalous access monitoring for CO/CF.

policy.name: AI Governance and Cloud Security Policy
policy.description: Defines AI governance for CO/CF including model risk, data governance, deployment guardrails, and cloud governance including shared responsibility and data residency.
